run.reading: failing Q1's or Q2's 'matches' rule is not evidence that ViT-L is worse than the comparator: the margin could not be shown. Only a CI wholly below 0 shows a deficit (prereg section 4).
run.limitation: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 against DDA's DINOv2 ViT-L/14: the same size, a different pretraining and patch size (prereg section 3)
run.environment: ViT-L trained and scored on torch 2.11.0+cu130, as were the P4 comparators DDA and CO-SPY (MEASURED); the S2-D ViT-B models and their P3 scores on a torch version their records do not hold (2.10.0+cu128 is the only earlier Kaggle record: NOT-VERIFIED for them). Recorded, not expected to matter; it bears on Q3 only (prereg section 7)
